body.estimand_functional: \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{causal}}(\theta)=\{T\subseteq\mathcal V:|T|=r,\ \exists t\text{ ordering }T\text{ with }\bar Q_{tt}\succ0\text{ and }L_t^{-1}P_t\Delta_eP_t^{\mathsf T}L_t^{-\mathsf T}\text{ diagonal and nonnegative for every }e\}\), where \(\bar Q=\sum_{e=1}^E\Delta_e\) and \(L_t\) is the unit-lower factor in the positive \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) factorization of \(\bar Q_{tt}\).

sampling_model.design: Independent multi-sample Gaussian covariance experiment across environments \(e\in\mathcal E\) for inference; the population necessity argument itself uses only the declared second-moment invariance and independence conditions.
sampling_model.units: For each environment, \(n_e\) independent centered observations \(Y_{ei}\in\mathbb R^d\).
sampling_model.treatment: Unknown soft interventions change exactly \(r\) observed structural-noise variances.  The baseline is a minimum-variance condition, shifts are nonnegative, and each target changes in at least one nonbaseline environment; no common calibration environment is required.
sampling_model.overlap: Covariances obey \(mI_d\preceq\Sigma_e\preceq MI_d\); no separation from covariance-profile collisions is imposed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical covariance tuple is used directly.  Stationary latent confounding and stationary measurement error cancel from population covariance differences, and the aggregate of those differences carries the changing subspace.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 2 characterizes the LIT output under latent confounding as a candidate superset of the observed intervention targets.

Theorem 1 gives uniqueness of a global joint diagonalizer under profile noncollinearity in a model that permits cyclic structural coefficients; it does not impose the present acyclic labeling constraint, target coverage, or an exact-rank designated carrier.

The identifiability theorem recovers an unmixing matrix up to scaling and permutation under variation and noncollinearity conditions; aggregate exact rank and aggregate shift-range inclusion here are consequences or explicit premises of a different acyclic target-fiber model, not cited coroICA assumptions.

The paper develops sign-and-permutation, distinct-eigenvalue, eigen-decomposition, and restricted rotation-set results for heteroskedastic structural VARs, not a complete family of labeled acyclic covariance-shift targets.
Theorem 1 constructs a test-inversion confidence set for a causal effect while retaining uncertainty over two linear causal structures.
The paper constructs random sets with pointwise and uniform asymptotic coverage for an identified set and its images by objective-function inversion.

Theorems 1--2 give weak-identification-robust chi-square inference for full and selected structural parameters in heteroskedastic models, not a geometry-free power envelope for a discrete target fiber.

body.tldr: Under a designed minimum-variance baseline, stationary latent confounding and measurement error cancel from covariance differences.  No common all-target reference is needed: the aggregate carrier \(\bar Q=\sum_{e=1}^E\Delta_e\) has rank \(r\) and contains every shift range whenever shifts are nonnegative and every target changes in at least one environment.  A size-\(r\) label set is compatible exactly when some ordering passes the aggregate principal-block \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) certificate, and every certificate has an acyclic Gaussian realization at any positive-definite baseline with strictly positive structural and measurement noises.  Subset-memoized pivots compute the complete family, while feasible-point augmentation gives always-nonempty honest family regions.  Information distance separates consistency from bounded-information impossibility, but local optimal certification is indexed by the full tangent-cone geometry rather than by distance alone.

project_justification.gap: Unknown-target methods with latent confounding return candidate supersets, target estimates, or latent-model/equivalence-class outputs rather than an exact labeled acyclic target fiber.  Covariance-difference methods recover a global mixing matrix only under profile separation.  Existing heteroskedastic diagonalization and rotation-set results do not characterize every labeled acyclic target set at profile collisions or lift each certificate to a positive-noise SCM; existing confidence-union coverage for a global diagonalizer also does not supply an always-nonempty region for this nonclosed exact-rank target-family model.
project_justification.niche: A minimum-variance baseline, nonnegative shifts, and panel-wide target coverage make the aggregate covariance difference a rank-\(r\) carrier.  Acyclicity then supplies a triangular labeling constraint that can be checked on candidate principal blocks even when no individual environment changes every target and individual changed columns are not globally identified.
project_justification.fill: The project gives an aggregate-carrier if-and-only-if labeled-fiber theorem, an arbitrary-baseline positive-noise converse, a signed-shift boundary witness, a complete subset recursion, and always-nonempty honest family inference by measurable feasible-point augmentation rather than a confidence union for a global diagonalizer.  It also gives a quantitative four-node collision and a geometry-indexed characterization showing why no universal local envelope can depend only on scalar information distance.

body.related_work: Yang, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash motivate unknown-target matching under latent confounding but characterize a candidate superset rather than the complete labeled fiber.  Varici et al. estimate intervention targets with latent variables, while Taeb et al. fit and score Gaussian latent-variable causal models with unknown additive interventions; neither output is an ordered-principal-block characterization of every compatible labeled acyclic target set, nor does it provide the present arbitrary-positive-baseline realization.  BACKSHIFT motivates covariance differencing and global diagonalization, but it permits cyclic structural coefficients and does not assume a common all-target reference or a designated exact-rank carrier; the present acyclic aggregate-carrier theorem is therefore a different result.  coroICA likewise motivates differencing away group-wise stationary noise and uses variation conditions for unmixing recovery; aggregate exact rank and aggregate range inclusion here are derived consequences of nonnegative covered shifts in the legal causal model, or explicit premises for standalone observed-tuple reconstruction, rather than attributed coroICA hypotheses.  Yang et al. analyze measurement error after a recoverable mixing matrix is available, whereas invariant positive measurement error here cancels before the target fiber is characterized.  Le and Nguyen give congruence simultaneous-diagonalization conditions and a numerical method for a complete Hermitian matrix family; that algebraic primitive does not impose the present labeled acyclic triangular completion or prove a legal positive-noise target-fiber converse.  Bacchiocchi et al. study sign/permutation equivalence, distinct heteroskedastic eigenvalues, and restricted rotation sets at multiplicity, not the complete discrete family of observed acyclic target labels.  Jaber et al. and Squires et al. make completeness over unknown-target equivalence classes algorithmically central under graphical oracle conditions; the present recursion uses exact aggregate covariance pivots.  The accepted-bank note eid_robust_backshift_uniform_distance_v1 establishes set-theoretic confidence-union coverage for a robust global BACKSHIFT-normalized diagonalizer from supplied nonempty covariance regions; it does not address this exact-rank labeled target family or the measurable feasible-point augmentation that guarantees a model-intersecting region on every sample.  Brown--Purves selection and Romano--Shaikh identified-set inversion motivate the inference construction, while Lewis and Andrews--Cheng motivate inference that remains valid near weak or disappearing identification; neither supplies the discrete target-family augmentation or the incident-geometry certification analysis here.  Wu et al. motivate causal differential-network analysis of biological perturbations, but do not furnish a covariance-profile target-fiber characterization under stationary latent confounding and measurement error.  Perturb-seq and Sci-Plex supply the experimental application domain, but the output here concerns effective structural-noise targets only when the narrower covariance model is scientifically defensible.
body.interpretation: For a Perturb-seq or Sci-Plex panel, each nonbaseline condition may reveal only part of the effective perturbation support.  The aggregate certificate combines those conditions without assigning privileged status to one arm.  Report the full compatible family, its compulsory intersection, and its possible union; interpret a singleton only when the augmented classification image is a singleton.  These labels describe effective variance-shift coordinates in the acyclic covariance model, not direct molecular binding sites, and uncertain or environment-dependent perturbation efficacy should be carried as abstention or a larger family rather than collapsed to a single target.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The model assumes environment-invariant structural coefficients, latent covariance, and measurement-error covariance, fixed dimension, a minimum-variance baseline, nonnegative structural-variance increments, and panel-wide coverage of every declared target.  For arbitrary observed tuples, positive-noise completion and recursive completeness explicitly require positive baseline covariance, exact rank of \(\bar Q\), and inclusion of every shift range in \(\operatorname{range}(\bar Q)\); these follow for tuples generated by the legal causal model but not from a target-block certificate alone.  Signed shifts remain outside the certificate because primitive variance feasibility then depends on unknown baseline structural variances.  The semialgebraic algorithm is a certification route rather than a transcriptome-scale complexity claim, and the exact local power value requires the complete incident tangent geometry.
body.honest_scope: The aggregate sharp fiber, positive-noise realization, subset recursion, measurable approximate selector, finite-sample family coverage, two-regime information boundary, and four-node collision rate are theorem-level claims.  The finite-sample sufficient threshold remains \(\sqrt{2}m\delta_n(\theta)>2c_{\alpha}+1\) on the stated confidence event, with the full \(x\)-indexed bound retained for consistency.  A universal one-variable local envelope is not claimed: the proved negative result gives an explicit geometry-indexed Gaussian optimization and same-distance witness showing that \(c\) alone is insufficient.  When \(r=1\), the aggregate result reduces to the ambiguity \(\{\{j\}:\bar Q_{jj}>0\}\); no stronger single-target identification is asserted.
